senses.gloss: (b. h.;Tafel of אָבָה) to desire, have an appetite for; to want.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>, beg. <he>ת׳ מיתת אביו</he> he wished for his father’s death; Tanḥ. Sh’moth 1.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:3:5">Y. Snh. II, 20ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>תָּאַבְתָּ דבר … שאני מַתְאִיבְךָ וכ׳</he> thou didst desire something forbidden to thee, I will make thee desire something permitted to thee.—

senses.gloss: to cause to desire. Y. Snh. l. c., v. supra.
